exported_guarantees.statement: A memory candidate must arise from an experience accessible to that actor; privileged world/event history is not sufficient.
Retention decisions use only actor-accessible state and predeclared consumer classes available at the selection checkpoint; future-only divergence cannot alter an earlier selection decision.
exported_guarantees.source_pointer: PA-06 / Selection is causal in time and NC-06

exported_guarantees.statement: Each actor has a finite semantic selected-memory capacity independent of lifetime and the number of distinct salient experiences, with deterministic pressure behavior when capacity is exceeded.
exported_guarantees.source_pointer: PA-06 / Retention and compaction and NC-05

exported_guarantees.statement: Selected memory preserves a bounded causal witness sufficient to explain a later consequence without requiring complete biography replay.
Memory may affect a later decision only through an explicitly declared action-family consumer while the existing actor-owned decision system retains choice authority.
Repeated ordinary experiences are grouped, summarized or forgotten, while distinct salient candidates still compete within the same finite selected-memory surface.
Memory may preserve historical reasons but does not own canonical truth, current belief, directed relationship values or ongoing domain obligations.
Player-caused and off-screen experiences follow the same actor-access and selection rules as other experiences; hidden lineage alone cannot alter actor output.
When a consequence remains active, compaction or save/load preserves its necessary reason within bounded memory or a bounded owner-controlled equivalent.
exported_guarantees.source_pointer: PA-06 / CF-02 and bounded active reason

exported_guarantees.statement: Recovery changes the relevance of experience through causal state changes and does not impose universal amnesia or automatic restoration of the starting town.

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: Memory is not a second mutable truth, present-belief, relationship or obligation store and cannot directly overwrite those owners.
exclusions_nonclaims.source_pointer: PA-06 / Ownership table and mechanism dispositions

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: Every world event or information transfer does not become a permanent autobiographical record.
Distinct individually salient experiences cannot escape the finite per-actor memory bound through uniqueness, overflow lists or unlimited active-reason exemptions.
The selector cannot inspect a future opportunity or replay privileged history to retain or resurrect exactly the episode later needed by a consumer.
Privileged hidden event or rumour lineage is not actor memory unless the actor legitimately experienced or acquired it.
The memory system does not force an actor choice or globally search actors and targets; the declared decision owner consumes eligible memory inputs.

The research establishes the existence of a finite semantic capacity but does not establish its numeric value, exact retention windows, storage schema, compaction algorithm, save footprint, lookup latency or population-scale performance.

reopen_conditions: Concrete accepted evidence shows that the selected actor-accessible witness cannot explain the declared later decision without complete biography replay.
A later implementation allows selected memory or active-reason state to grow without a finite bound across distinct salient experiences.
A later selector can change an earlier retention decision based only on future divergence or privileged replay.
A later consumer demonstrates that the recommendation duplicates or mutates current truth, belief, relationship or obligation authority.
A concrete effective path allows hidden lineage or inaccessible events to alter actor memory or output despite actor-visible inputs being fixed.
escalate_if: A consumer needs exact selection, ranking, causal-witness or scenario nuance beyond the exported guarantees.
A disposition would be reclassified, especially a REJECT or LATER / empirical row.
A proposed consumer requires exact numeric capacity, retention, decay, compaction, storage, save, lookup or performance values.
Live accepted identity or canonical PA-06 source bytes contradict this capsule.

dispositions.source_key: Causal-time selection from declared dimensions/consumer classes
Finite per-actor selected-memory budget + deterministic pressure policy
Salience by stake, relevance, novelty and declared consumer class
Distinct detail loss, relevance decay and state repair
Active-effect reason pin or owner-controlled equivalent
Direct memory writes to current belief/relationship values
Hidden event or rumour lineage as actor memory
Global one-size-fits-all salience, TTL or slot constants
Final storage schema, compaction/index algorithm and CPU budget
